summary: Full backend + frontend regression on FitConnect. Wrote pytest suite covering auth guards, public services, customer enrollment (incl. duplicate + capacity guards), provider onboarding (apply -> pending -> admin approve -> create service -> approve -> toggle visibility -> add class), admin stats and RBAC. All 15 backend tests PASS. Frontend UI verified via Playwright: landing, /app/browse (3 seeded cards), activity detail (schedule + enroll), /app/enrollments (list + cancel), /app/admin (stats), /app/admin/providers (approve/reject buttons), /app/admin/services (approve/reject/toggle-visibility with visible toast), /app/become-provider apply form.

minor.issue: Blocks only when provider_status=='approved' or role=='admin'. A user with provider_status=='pending' or 'rejected' can re-apply and overwrite prior application. Not breaking, but consider disallowing re-apply while pending.
Does not verify target user exists (silent no-op if wrong id). Consider 404 if user not found.
Same — updates without existence check; silent no-op on invalid id. Consider 404.
Any provider edit resets status back to 'pending'. Intentional? If yes, document; otherwise, only bump to pending on material changes.

issues: Dark theme with #39FF14 neon green accents renders correctly, contrast OK, buttons have data-testid attributes throughout.

action_items: Optional: harden admin approve/reject endpoints with 404 when target id missing.
Optional: disallow /api/provider/apply while already pending to avoid overwriting an in-flight request.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~535 lines and mixes models, auth, routes, and seed in a single file — split into routers/ (auth, provider, admin, customer) and models.py as it grows.
get_current_user reads token from cookie OR Authorization Bearer — good; expired sessions are not proactively deleted (minor cleanup opportunity).
Frontend AuthContext.checkAuth swallows all errors as null-user (fine); no distinction between network error vs 401. Minor UX improvement.
MongoDB _id properly excluded everywhere via projection {'_id':0}.
All frontend interactive elements carry kebab-case data-testid — good testability.
test_credentials: Pre-seeded sessions used: admin=test_session_admin_001 (user_adminseed01, rrlfnlstrategy@gmail.com), customer=test_session_cust_001 (user_custseed01). Bearer or session_token cookie both work.
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral users+sessions in Mongo (test_database.users / user_sessions) and clean them up in try/finally. Also cleaned up cust seed side-effects (provider_status, enrollments) after UI run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Correct customer-enrollments route is /app/enrollments (not /app/my-classes). Sidebar labels 'MY CLASSES' but the path is /app/enrollments. All backend endpoints working; seeded provider user_demoprovider01 owns 3 approved+visible services with classes. Backend tests are in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py, use pytest.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues found. During UI exploration the initial test script mistakenly navigated to '/app/my-classes' which is a non-existent route and falls through to Navigate('/'); the correct route is '/app/enrollments'. This is a test-script issue, not an app bug (nav item in DashboardLayout correctly points to /app/enrollments).
